narrativeProgression.description: The interviewer asks about the interviewee's experience coaching Billy Joe for his world title fight at 24.
The interviewee explains he took over coaching Billy Joe a few weeks before the fight because he was struggling with his weight.
The interviewee details his strategy of focusing on round management and calming Billy Joe's nerves, even lying to him about winning a round.
The interviewer asks about the acceptance of a young coach and the interviewee explains his approach of managing expectations and focusing on Billy Joe's mindset.
The interviewer asks about question marks on the interviewee's ability and he responds by saying that there were doubts after the fight, but not before.
The interviewer asks about Billy Joe's performance as an underdog and the interviewee explains that it’s about mindset and not letting doubts affect performance.
The interviewer asks how the interviewee motivates his fighters and he discusses the importance of focusing on what’s actually happening in the ring, rather than feelings.
The interviewer talks about Billy Joe as a fighter and how proud he is of him, while the interviewee expresses confidence in Billy Joe's ability to win his upcoming fight.
The interviewee predicts the upcoming fight will come down to tactical awareness and understanding the opponent's strategy.
